correctness.rationale: Direct Apéry minimality and full-tree effectiveness criteria yield exactly six pair families. Threefold intersection contains one triple for each genus, and subtracting its three memberships leaves a rational series simplifying to z^5(1+z+z^3)/((1-z)(1-z^5)). Exceptional genus three has generator four effective. Standalone direct-decomposition enumeration through genus 90 reproduces pair memberships and all coefficients; finite checks supplement general proof.
